title: Dispatch FLE 6: A Voice Is Heard at the Graveside
summary: The sealed coffin remains closed, but its inscription changes.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: A caretaker heard a woman say, “Let her keep it,” beside the new grave. The inscription, which had named Dr. Miriam Voss without dates, now carries the years of Lydia’s mother. No workman admits cutting the stone.

Dr. Saye says a voice and an altered inscription do not identify the speaker. Inspector Voss has lifted the watch but keeps the burial records under seal. His sister says she is less concerned with the voice than with the family whose memories the inquiry nearly erased.
